name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 111 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 17% fewer than the week before, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 111 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli forces continue air strikes across Gaza, killing multiple civilians including children, while hospitals report severe staff trauma and bereavement. In the West Bank, Israeli settlers attacked a Palestinian town, wounding three olive harvesters and prompting a mother to live in fear of her son’s killer, while a settler council head shapes policy in the area. The UN rights office warns that displacement in Gaza is deepening into a nightmare and calls for an urgent UN protection force. Gaza doctors are struggling with overwork and trauma amid the ongoing war. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker fortsetter luftangrep over Gaza, og dreper flere sivile, inkludert barn, mens sykehus rapporterer om alvorlig personaltraume og sorg. På Vestbredden angrep israelske bosettere en palestinsk by, såret tre olivenplukkere og fikk en mor til å leve i frykt for sin sønns drapsmann, mens lederen for en bosetterråd former politikken i området. FN-s rettskontor advarer om at fordrivelsen i Gaza utvikler seg til et mareritt og etterlyser en umiddelbar FN-beskyttelsesstyrke. Gaza-leger er overarbeidet og traumatiserte i den pågående krigen. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
